Generated Narrative: CodeSystem series-type

This case-sensitive code system http://fhirfli.dev/fhir/ig/cicada/CodeSystem/series-type defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
standard StandardThe routine, age-based series.
risk RiskA series indicated by a patient risk condition, such as travel, occupation, pregnancy, or a chronic medical condition.
evaluation-only Evaluation OnlyA series used only to evaluate administered doses; it never produces a forecast.

name: SeriesTypeCS
title: Series Type Code System
description: CDSi series type: whether a patient series is the routine schedule, one indicated by a risk condition, or evaluation-only. Mirrors the seriesType attribute of the CDSi antigen supporting data.

concept.definition: A series indicated by a patient risk condition, such as travel, occupation, pregnancy, or a chronic medical condition.
A series used only to evaluate administered doses; it never produces a forecast.
